subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona TTS SecretRefs become startup-fatal under the current eager activation contract, or should this PR wait for or align with the optional-TTS degradation work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: This PR activates SecretRefs that current releases ignore, so an existing missing persona TTS key can change from a localized TTS failure into a Gateway startup failure; tests cannot choose that upgrade policy.

options.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
options.body: Fix and prove this collector change, then land it after or alongside an accepted narrow optional-TTS startup policy.

options.title: Accept fail-fast activation
options.body: Land after the code and proof blockers are resolved, explicitly accepting that missing active persona TTS refs can prevent Gateway startup.

recommendation.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
recommendation.body: Fix and prove this collector change, then land it after or alongside an accepted narrow optional-TTS startup policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision extends the secrets activation and fail-fast contract introduced by their merged external-secrets work.
